newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Central Bank Bond rate steady at 2.617 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Central Bank Bond rate steady at 2.617 pct.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank sold 7.25 billion reais in 56-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC) at a benchmark overnight rate of 2.617 percent a month at its weekly auction, the same rate of last week's tender, dealers said.

The Central Bank also sold 2.925 billion reais of 42-day BBC's at an overnight rate of 2.641 percent a month. Dealers said the sale of 42-day bonds was aimed at adjusting the market's liquidity this month.
The 42-day bonds will mature on October 16, while the 56-day bonds will mature on October 30.
Today's auction is expected to drain 2.675 billion reais from the banking system, with 7.5 billion reais in old bonds coming due Wednesday.
